subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Vishnu and Vignesh are always __like two peas in a pod. __
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"like two peas in a pod"** means:

 
 
• Very similar to each other (बहुत समान होना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Sarah and her twin sister are** like two peas in a pod**; they have the same tastes and interests.
 
• **Very similar to each other** refers to two people or things that are almost identical in appearance, behavior, or characteristics. (बहुत समान होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The two brothers are **very similar to each other** in their mannerisms and looks.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Very similar to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Happy and compassionate** (खुश और दयालु): Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment and having a strong feeling of sympathy and sadness for the suffering or bad luck of others and wanting to help them.

 
 
• **Example:** She is always **happy and compassionate **towards the needy.
 
 
 
• **Smart and intelligent** (चतुर और बुद्धिमान): Having or showing a quick-witted intelligence.
 
 
• **Example:** He is very **smart and intelligent**, always coming up with innovative solutions.
 
 
 
• **Good in every way** (हर तरीके से अच्छा): Being excellent or satisfactory in all aspects.
 
 
• **Example:** The new employee is **good in every way **and fits well with our team.
 
 

55:Tb30,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
